ios.desc:
* Do you want to make 3D animations without having to spend hundreds of dollars or subscribe to a service?

* Do you want to make 3D animations without having to learn a new, complicated piece of software?

Fortunately, Minima Animator is just the simple, powerful 3D animation tool you're looking for. 

FEATURES:
- Rich, limitless 3D animation
    - Create animations as long as you want
    - Innovative keyframing system
    - Complex lighting support
    - Change the duration of your project at any time
- Powerful exporting options
    - Export to .MOV, .MP4, .GIF, or .PNG sequence
    - Capable of exporting at 4K resolution
- Character rigging
    - Add skeletons to 3D models to rig characters
    - Automatically rig character models
    - Animate rigged characters with quick, clean joint drawer interface
- Large library of assets available out-of-the-box
    - Over 150 completely free assets included
    - Includes asset management system
    - Export and import directories of assets
- Cross-platform compatibility
    - Universal purchase (purchase Minima Animator for iPad and receive a free copy for Mac)
    - Open projects on either iPad or Mac
    - Sync projects over iCloud Drive
- Powerful importing options
    - Import Minima animations, Minima models, and images anytime
    - Create your own 3D assets with Minima Sculptor and import them effortlessly
- Detailed Help Center
    - Comprehensive articles about technical concepts and animation practices included in Help Center
- Tutorials and example projects available online at MagMHJ.com
